column1: # Personal-score responses of the game's mode scripts, by script group and event rank.
# CREDIT. This table is taken from libfilmshell (OpenSpartan, https://github.com/OpenSpartan/libfilmshell,
# MIT licence, copyright (c) 2026 OpenSpartan; licence text in LICENSE-libfilmshell next to this file), file
# `src/game/events_data.rs`, commit ad17521 ("Generated from the game's files" in that file's own header).
# The maintainers of libfilmshell derived the event trees from the game's mode scripts; this module did not
# WHAT IS TAKEN. For each of the 11 groups of event scripts of that file, every response that gives personal
# score: the script's name for the response, the points and the English text the game shows with them, the
# string ids of the response's own text, and whether the id is unsure (one the walk of the tree cannot place
# for certain: inside a script loop, or in Firefight's own files).
# WHAT IS TRANSFORMED. Only the responses that give score are kept (423 rows of 4,804 ids and 739
# responses); the other responses (medals, announcer lines, kill-feed lines) are not. A group is named by
# its script files joined by "+", in the file's own order. The id of an event is the "rank" of this module
# (`lecture.EvenementDeJeu.Rang`). The table is regenerated from libfilmshell, not edited by hand.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated): group, rank (decimal), response name, points, English text, text word ids
# (hexadecimal, comma-separated, may be empty), unsure (0 or 1).
